answers.answer: Confirmed BEAT on the reported quarter, but the +6.51% is NOT the earnings reaction and must not be tracked as post-earnings drift. AMAT fiscal Q3 2026 (period ended 2026-07-26) reported after the close on 2026-08-13: EPS $3.50 actual vs $3.3944 consensus = +3.11% surprise (beat); revenue $9,115M vs $7,302M prior-year = +24.83% YoY, which matches your figure -- but I could not source a revenue CONSENSUS this run, so revenue_consensus is null and I am NOT calling a revenue beat. Guide is a separate and favourable signal: AMAT raised current-quarter EPS guidance and forecast FQ4 revenue above Street. So quarter_verdict=beat, guide_verdict=above. The correction: the actual earnings reaction was NEGATIVE. 2026-08-13 close $534.54 -> 2026-08-14 close $507.18 = -5.12% on the day after the print; 2-day drift +0.14%, 5-day drift -7.90%. Your +6.51% is 2026-09-18 ($417.40 -> $444.57), 24 sessions after the print, and belongs to the India/$5B news window, not to earnings. Attributing it to the print is the mirror image of the G58/G75 errors.
